mapper.select: SELECT sq.*, s.sname as studentName, q.quiz_title as quizTitle, q.total_score as quizTotalScore FROM studentms.student_quiz_score sq INNER JOIN studentms.s s ON sq.sid = s.sid INNER JOIN studentms.quiz q ON sq.quiz_id = q.quiz_id WHERE sq.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND sq.sid = #{sid};

UPDATE studentms.student_quiz_score
total_score = #{score.totalScore},
obtained_score = #{score.obtainedScore},
submit_time = #{score.submitTime},
is_submitted = #{score.isSubmitted},
is_graded = #{score.isGraded},
WHERE score_id = #{score.scoreId};
